note: Not `nix flake check`: that also evaluates the Linux hosts, which needs SSH credentials for the private cogsworth repo, so it cannot go green on a mac. This covers both darwin configs end to end (home-manager files included), every formatter, shellcheck, the pi wrapper's decisions, pi-broker's protocol and forge's VM boundary, in about half a minute. Inside pi's sandbox it needs --allow-nix for the daemon socket.
